programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall. Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide. The Oslo Philharmonic was celebrated for its fresh, open sound and for Jansons’s passionate interpretations of works by Dmitri Shostakovich, Richard Strauss, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, and Béla Bartók. In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Jansons guides the orchestra through the powerful Suite from Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 32, Op. 111
programme.desc: Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends. Not only does pianist Tom Beghin perform Beethoven’s trilogy of pianistic masterpieces on a magnificent new replica of Beethoven’s Broadwood piano, he uses a reconstruction of the Gehörmaschine that was mounted on the composer’s piano so he could continue to create music as his hearing declined.

programme.title: Orff - O Fortuna (Carmina Burana)
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton). Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27. This performance at the magnificent Teatro Real in Madrid, Spain is part of the Europakonzert 2011. Sir Simon Rattle leads the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27. After the disastrous premiere of the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in 1897, Rachmaninoff seriously doubted his ability as a symphonist. Almost a decade later, in October 1906, he started composing his Symphony No. 2. Months of revisions followed. He finished this large orchestral work in the summer of 1907, followed by a highly successful 1908 premiere in St. Petersburg. This performance at the magnificent Teatro Real in Madrid, Spain is part of the Europakonzert 2011.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: In this exciting documentary, we go behind-the-scenes at the Zurich Opera House and follow the intensive progress of the new production of Gioachino Rossini's Il Barbiere di Siviglia with Vesselina Kasarova in the role of Rosina. The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production. In this exciting documentary, we go behind-the-scenes at the Zurich Opera House and follow the intensive progress of the new production of Gioachino Rossini's Il Barbiere di Siviglia with Vesselina Kasarova in the role of Rosina. The film also shows preparations for other productions, such as a workshop for Richard Wagner's Siegfried directed by Robert Wilson, and a rehearsal for Igor Stravinsky's Le Sacre du Printemps with choreography by Heinz Spoerli. This film opens the curtain to understanding an opera house’s many exciting facets.

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 1, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 1 in F minor, Op. 120. Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 1 in F minor, Op. 120.

programme.title: Ravel - Boléro
programme.desc: French conductor Adrien Perruchon and the Flanders Symphony Orchestra take us on a musical journey to Argentine, Spain, and Mexico, in this March 1, 2017 concert performance at Concertgebouw Brugge in Belgium. The program includes Édouard Lalo’s Spanish Symphony for violin and orchestra, Op. 21, featuring Czech violinist Josef Špaček as the soloist; Mathias Coppens’ Music for Orchestra, Op. 12; Alberto Ginastera’s Dances from Estancia, Op. 8a; Aaron Copland’s El Salón México; Maurice Ravel’s famous Boléro; and Arturo Márquez’s Danzón No. 2.

programme.title: Karl Jenkins - The Armed Man: A Mass for Peace
programme.desc: In this truly unique historic occasion Sir Karl Jenkins conducts The World Orchestra for Peace and around 2,000 singers from nearly 30 countries who joined together to Sing for Peace in Berlin. The Armed Man: A Mass for Peace by Welsh composer Sir Karl Jenkins is the most performed work by any living composer. For this truly unique, historic occasion, Welsh composer Sir Karl Jenkins conducts The World Orchestra for Peace and around 2,000 singers from nearly 30 countries to Sing for Peace at the Berlin's Mercedes Benz Arena on November 2, 2018. Soloists are vocalists Leah-Marian Jones, Yumeji Matsufuji, Pauline Rathmann, Amir Aziz, violinist Krzysztof Wisniewski and cellist Valentino Worlitzsch. The Armed Man: A Mass for Peace is the most performed work by any living composer. This performance is the largest ever staged, and was uniquely performed in synchronization with a specially commissioned war-archive film that reinforces the narrative of the work - the build up to war, war itself, and the consequences of war. Projected on to five giant screens, the film delivers a poignant backdrop to the moving musical narration providing the audience with a powerful and emotional multimedia experience.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: The then-newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra presents this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003, under the baton of Claudio Abbado. The soloists Eteri Gvazava (soprano) and Anna Larsson (mezzo-soprano) are accompanied by the singers of the Orfeón Donostiarra choir. "It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling," declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra. Claudio Abbado had formed this ensemble from famous instrumentalists, celebrated chamber-musicians and experienced soloists from the world's best orchestras, and the event was sold out months in advance. In this performance, the magnificent soloists Eteri Gvazava (soprano) and Anna Larsson (mezzo-soprano) are accompanied by Orfeón Donostiarra choir.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: A symphony of tender, transparent beauty and comforting, childlike simplicity. The work's unique portrayal of paradise through a child's perspective offers a refreshing contrast to the more complex and often turbulent works in Mahler's output. Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Beethoven and Liszt
programme.desc: As part of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), Philipp Scheucher (Austria, 1993) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Fantasia Op. 77; Menuetto: ‘Moderato e grazioso’ from Beethoven’s Sonata No. 18 in E-flat major, Op. 31 No. 3; and Franz Liszt’s transcription of the first movement, ‘Allegro con brio’, from Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in May 2021. Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Philipp Scheucher (Austria, 1993) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Fantasia Op. 77; Menuetto: ‘Moderato e grazioso’ from Beethoven’s Sonata No. 18 in E-flat major, Op. 31 No. 3; and Franz Liszt’s transcription of the first movement, ‘Allegro con brio’, from Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in May 2021.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists created by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015 Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. Whereas it took the composer over a decade to complete his first symphony, he penned his Symphony No. 2 in just a few months, during his summer sojourn in the restful Austrian village of Pörtschach in 1877. Nicknamed his ‘Pastoral’ symphony, the work is arguably the most sunny and optimistic of Brahms’s four symphonies. Lyrical in character, it features joyful melodies. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler and Schönberg
programme.desc: Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Arnold Schönberg’s Pelleas et Melisande, Op.5. Recorded 2006 at Musikverein Vienna. The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication. Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Schönberg’s Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5. The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in Vienna in 1986, by Abbado’s initiative. The orchestra's high level of artistic quality and its international success have moved important conductors and soloists to work with the ensemble.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 6 in B-flat major, BWV 1051. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 6 in B-flat major, BWV 1051. Contrary to the other five concertos, this piece does not include violins, instead offering the floor to the lower strings and the harpsichord.

programme.title: Fischer conducts Prokofiev and Stravinsky
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2. Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in Handel’s oratorio Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno (The Triumph of Time and Truth). Sabine Devieilhe and Franco Fagioli are the main singers. Recorded at the Festival d’Aix-en-Provence in 2016. Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging. In this oratorio, the characters Time and Disillusion try to convince Beauty to abandon Pleasure for less fleeting gratifications. Sabine Devieilhe is unquestionably the star that carries the show, always impressive in technique, range and timbre. Her sparring and harmonizing with Franco Fagioli is magnificent. Other soloists are Michael Spyres and Sara Mingardo. Recorded at the Festival d’Aix-en-Provence in 2016.

programme.title: Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's First Piano Concerto with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. It was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival. Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz. Debargue's performance of Ravel's concerto is followed by Gabriel Fauré's Barcarolle No. 4. The performance was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano) Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians. The different pieces are meant to be a set, just like the Brandenburg concertos.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021. The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. Mahler completed his first symphony in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine’ some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: The Berlin Philharmonic in Tokyo
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. Zajedno dožive brojne komične zgode, u koje Maša upadne zbog svoje razigranosti i znatiželje.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Ami g show
programme.desc: Aktuelni i ekskluzivni gosti gosti, lude igrice i prepoznatljiv humor Ognjena Amidžića razlozi su zbog kojih je Ami G Show najpopularnija late night emisija u Srbiji. Već 17 godina utorak je bez izuzetka rezervisan za Ami G Show, a tako će biti i u ovoj televizijskoj sezoni. U novom redizajniranom studiju koji može da parira svetskim late night emisijama, Ognjen će ugostiti poznate ličnosti iz različitih sfera - od glumaca i pevača, preko sportista, do političara - i stavljaće ih na izazove u kojima niste mogli ni da ih zamislite.

programme.title: Seljaci, serija
programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju "Seljaci"? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.title: Ljubav navika panika, serija
programme.desc: Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno...oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije...oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika da li sve postaje panika.....

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: Nova sezona „Trenutak iz sna donosi priče žena čiji fizički izgled svedoči o decenijama stresa, tuge, teškog fizičkog rada i trauma. Njihov fizički izgled odražava godine skrivanja od pogleda drugih iz straha da ne budu osuđene, a svaki pogled u ogledalo ih podseća na njihove unutrašnje borbe, svaki susret sa ljudima ih suočava sa osećajem srama i odbačenosti. Kroz suze, bol i odlučnost pronašle su put ka svetlu. Njihove priče su izuzetne, njihova hrabrost nadmašuje granice mogućeg, a njihova transformacija je inspiracija za sve. Tim vrhunskih stručnjaka učiniće sve da ove žene podignu iz pepela, obnove njihovu veru u sebe i pronađu unutrašnju snagu. Hirurzi i anti-aging eksperti kombinovali su svoje svoje veštine kako bi obnovili, pomladili kožu i uklonili mnoge fizičke nedostatke, pomažući ženama da povrate svežinu i vitalnost. Stomatolozi stvaraju blistav osmeh koji zrači samopouzdanjem i zdravljem. Psiholozi pružaju emocionalnu podršku i pomažu ženama da prevaziđu unutrašnje izazove, prebrode prošlost i pronađu mir. Frizeri, šminkeri i stilisti brižljivo oblikuju izgled, naglašavajući individualnu lepotu i autentičnost svake žene. Svaka transformacija je poput čuda koje se odigrava pred našim očima. U serijalu „Trenutak iz sna, ove izuzetne žene donose hrabru odluku da se odvoje od svojih najbližih dok traje njihova transformacija. A onda, kao najlepša nagrada za hrabrost koju su pokazale, na samom velikom finalu čeka ih porodica koja ih nakon nekoliko nedelja po prvi put vidi u potpuno novom izdanju. Trenutak kada se ponovno sretnu sa svojim voljenima je pravi trenutak iz sna, jer je obasjan osmesima, suzama radosnicama, neprocenjivim zagrljajima i nevericom.Ovaj serijal nije samo priča o transformaciji, već i o ljubavi, hrabrosti, podršci i ljudskosti koju dugujemo jedni drugima. „Trenutak iz sna je prilika da kroz svaku epizodu proživite emotivno putovanje, zato ne propustite novu sezonu, svakog četvrtka u 22 časa na televiziji Pink.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Iz kreativne kuhinje produkcijske kuće "Shadow production" dolazi nova sezona najhumanijeg TV serijala "Kuća od srca". Najdramatičnija sezona do sada donosi snažne priče o ljudima koji su se našli na ivici egzistencije. Oni nemaju dom kakav zaslužuju, a zbog neadekvatnih uslova koji prete da ugroze živote i zdravlje porodice, najviše ispaštaju deca. Usled susreta sa surovim udarcima života deca mogu da izgube pravo na svoje detinjstvo. Urušeni plafoni i zidovi puni vlage svedoče o tome da su ove porodice za dlaku izbegle smrt. Njihove sudbine su neizvesne, a potresne ispovesti ostaviće gledaoce bez daha.

programme.title: Ljubavni život Budimira Trajkovića, film
programme.desc: Obitelj Trajković gradi mostove. Time se bavio djed, sin, a isto se očekuje i od unuka Budimira. Za njega su, međutim, mostovi prokletstvo. Zbog gradnje mostova obitelj sestalno seli od mjesta do mjesta uništavajući njegov ljubavni život, no, jednom se požele skrasiti. Tada i unuk Budimir po prvi put doživljava potpunu ljubav koja mu pomaže da odraste... "Ljubavni život Budimira Trajkovića" izvrsna je komedija kojom se je proslavio tada mladi srpski redatelj Dejan Karaklajić. Uspjeh filma svakako je garantirala čitava plejada legendarnih jugoslavenskih glumaca poput Velimira Živojinovića, Milene Dravić i Ljubiše Samardžića.

programme.title: Šifra Despot
programme.desc: "Šifra Despot" je elegična socijalna komedija naravi i mentaliteta, smeštena u ambijent metropole, ali podjednako i u autentična srpska predgrađa, varošice, gradove, sela i zaseoke. Ne napuštajući ni jednog trenutka životne vratolomije glavnog junaka serije, pomalo nespretnog i taličnog, ali veoma talentovanog kompjuterskog programera Despota Despotovića, kog igra mladi glumac Đorđe Marković, serija će u tematskom, vizuelnom i socijalnom smislu oslikati vreme u kom živimo. Nastojanje glavnog lika da preživi i da obezbedi sopstvenu egzistenciju kao jedini zaposleni u svojoj softverskoj kući "Despot & Co", u svakoj od 45 epizoda prve sezone, vodiće njega i gledaoce serije na najrazličitije lokacije i socijalne sredine - na farmu ćuraka, u fitnis centar, bolnice, fabrike, advokatske kancelarije, u nevladine organizacije, političke partije, staračke domove, sportske klubove, kladionice, banke, škole plesa, modne salone i mnoga druga mesta - što predstavlja izvanredan dramaturški i scenaristički okvir za razvoj komediografskih odnosa, kojim će pored društveno odgovorih tema, koje će serija tretirati, gledaoci biti u prilici da se zabave, relaksiraju uz zdrav i nepatvoreni humor na temljima srpskog mentaliteta - koji autor Radoš Bajić izvanredno dobro poznaje.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Ami g show
programme.desc: Aktuelni i ekskluzivni gosti gosti, lude igrice i prepoznatljiv humor Ognjena Amidžića razlozi su zbog kojih je Ami G Show najpopularnija late night emisija u Srbiji. Već 17 godina utorak je bez izuzetka rezervisan za Ami G Show, a tako će biti i u ovoj televizijskoj sezoni. U novom redizajniranom studiju koji može da parira svetskim late night emisijama, Ognjen će ugostiti poznate ličnosti iz različitih sfera - od glumaca i pevača, preko sportista, do političara - i stavljaće ih na izazove u kojima niste mogli ni da ih zamislite.

programme.title: Nasledstvo
programme.desc: Dve žene koje se nikada u životu nisu srele otrovane su istim otrovom, istoga dana. Jedna je devedesetogodišnja vlasnica predratnog hotela Pariz u kojem je vreme stalo, a druga je sekretarica tajkuna koji pokušava da se domogne hotela u centru grada, kako bi na njegovom mestu izgradio najveći tržni centar na Balkanu. Ko je ubica dve žene, a ko neverovatni naslednik hotela i celokupne imovine ubijene vlasnice? U mnogobrojnim obrtima, u vrtlogu para i ljubavi, odanosti i izdaje, iskrenosti i podlosti, sveta siromašnih i sveta bogatih, poštenja i lopovluka, časti i pohlepe, skromnosti i snobovštine, sukoba generacija, porodičnih lomova i društvenih previranja - lome se i sudbine čak i onih koji u tome nisu želeli da učestvuju.

programme.title: Kad na vrbi rodi grožđe, serija
programme.desc: Serija se po malo, a nekada i malo više, podsmeva bahatostima, mitomaniji, primitvluku, glupostima i besmislicama na koje, naši junaci svoga mentaliteta radi, najčešće, život utrošiše...Ova serija govori o naravima građana malog mesta, negde na Balkanu. Oni se međusobno prepiru, nekada i posvade, često zavole, a i razilaze...ali su jedni na druge upućeni, i jedni bez drugih ne mogu. Postoje trenuci kada je nekome od njih teško, kada se desi prirodno zlo, često radost, a i žalost, oni se okupljaju jedni oko drugih, pomažu, tu su da se nađu i da učine što mogu. Oni su komšije, bez obzira na ime, veru i naciju...

programme.title: Villa Maria, serija
programme.desc: Porodici Jurak nacionalizovan je veći deo imovine nakon Drugog svetskog rata, ali svejedno nisu ostali siromašni. Stanuju u dobrom zagrebačkom kvartu. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) je pedesetogodišnjak, vodi porodični biznis koji uključuje lanac restorana i hotel u centru grada, koji je počeo da gradi još u vreme socijalizma, ali ga je u vlasništvo preuzeo tokom privatizacije devedesetih novcem svoje tete Mitzy. Njegova žena Ana Jurak (Ksenija Pajić), u ranim četrdesetim, rodila mu je dvoje dece- Ivana i Doru. Ana je napustila studije prava kad ga je upoznala i posvetila se brizi o porodici i uz pomoć kućne pomoćnice, brizi o samoj sebi-shopping, bazen i tračanje, omiljene su joj obaveze. Kako god bilo, ona je u svakom slučaju temelj familije. Ćerka Dora (Jelena Veljača) ima 20 godina i studira ekonomiju. Otac je obožava i ne prihvata činjenicu da je već odavno došla u godine da ima dečka i svoju intimu. Razmažena tatina kćer. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) radi s ocem u firmi. Zgodan zagrebački dečko, dvadesetpetogodišnjak, ali neodgovoran, sklon porocima, ukratko, loš karakter lepog lica. S druge strane, nalazi se porodica bankara Maksa Lovreka (Ante Čedo Martinić), koji Jurakovoj firmi daje veliki kredit za preuzimanje malotrgovinskog lanca. On i Tomislav Jurak (ne)prijatelji su još od falultetskih dana. Uz posao, Jurakovi i Lovrekovi povezani su i privatno, a razdoblje prividnog prijateljstva s početka priče ubrzo prerasta u suparništvo. Max Lovrek oženjen je Vesnom Lovrek (Barbara Vicković), ženom sumnjivog karaktera, koja je pritom Maksu neverna. Bankar Lovrek iz prvog braka ima sina Svena (Sven Madžarević), 2o godišnjaka, prilično povučenog, skromnog dečka. Maks kuje zaveru protiv Juraka s Jurakovim ambicioznim sinom Ivanom. Treća glavna ekipa su bolesna majka Dunja (Nada Gačešić Livaković) i njen sin Luka (Damir Markovina), pametan i obrazovan mladić koji neumorno radi kod Jurakovih, ali ne razume da ga oni iskorištavaju. Ima i razloga za slepilo: voli Jurakovu ćerku, Doru. Njihovu vezu Tomislav Jurak nikad ne bi dopustio...

programme.title: Ami g show
programme.desc: Aktuelni i ekskluzivni gosti gosti, lude igrice i prepoznatljiv humor Ognjena Amidžića razlozi su zbog kojih je Ami G Show najpopularnija late night emisija u Srbiji. Već 17 godina utorak je bez izuzetka rezervisan za Ami G Show, a tako će biti i u ovoj televizijskoj sezoni. U novom redizajniranom studiju koji može da parira svetskim late night emisijama, Ognjen će ugostiti poznate ličnosti iz različitih sfera - od glumaca i pevača, preko sportista, do političara - i stavljaće ih na izazove u kojima niste mogli ni da ih zamislite.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of China - Zhengzhou
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2024 - GP of Binh Dinh (Vietnam Ski) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Hello Sailors! It’s such a great pleasure to welcome you to the new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We’re setting off on yet another incredible journey sailing the Adriatic starting from the lush and picturesque Neretva valley and the town of Ploče. Stay tuned and enjoy the ride!

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: 2019 - Slalom 1 World Cup Lee Valley Welcome to the Lee Valley White Water Centre just outside London for the World Cup 1 of the ICF Canoe Slalom. We will be talking you through the action of this competition: it is going to be canoe single men followed by the kayak single women. Follow us for slalom competition at its highest level. Relive the best moments in Lee Valley 2019.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: 2019 - Slalom 2 World Cup Bratislava Welcome to Bratislava, in Slovakia, for round two of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. Mallory Franklin, Kimberley Woods and Jessica Fox were the top three in Lee Valley last weekend, however Mallory Franklin and Kimberley Woods will not be racing this weekend while Jessica Fox got eliminated in the semi-final. In the C1 men's the medalists from last weekend will also not be racing here, but there are some big names in the lineup. Let's dive into the action in Bratislava.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta, 2017
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the TPR has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most beautifun regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of China - Zhengzhou
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2024 - GP of Binh Dinh (Vietnam Ski) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Hello Sailors! It’s such a great pleasure to welcome you to the new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We’re setting off on yet another incredible journey sailing the Adriatic starting from the lush and picturesque Neretva valley and the town of Ploče. Stay tuned and enjoy the ride!

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Novalja, NP Plitvička jezera, Rijeka, Opatija Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta, 2017
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the TPR has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most beautifun regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Bora Bora: Paddling Paradise
programme.desc: In Bora Bora: Paddling Paradise Nikolai visits the crystal blue lagoons, encounters sharks and stingrays and witnesses the 6th edition of the Muramur surfski race in Tahiti. The intensive 38 km race meandering through reefs that surround the mystic island of Bora Bora is bound to make you pack your flippers and book a flight to the exotic French Polynesia.You can now watch this exclusive show that will take you to one of the world’s most beautiful sceneries on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Chasing Jaguars
programme.desc: A group of brave kayakers get on a plane and fly all the way from Europe to Costa Rica looking for exciting adventures and fast rapids. In Chasing Jaguars, this group of friends will discover the nature and wildlife of the Costa Rican Whitewater paradise. This unforgettable kayak-experience in Costa Rica takes us to the middle of the jungle between snakes and wild animals as the group chase after jaguars in the wild depth of the tropical landscape. They will go against fast waters, challenge heat and cold waters and enjoy a trip of a lifetime. Join them in Chasing Jaguars, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2019 - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: 2019 - Slalom 4 World Cup Markkleeberg We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Bass By Kayak
programme.desc: Bass by Kayak follows a small expedition party formed by four adventurers crossing from the Australian mainland to Tasmania in sea kayaks. With a 300 km separation, a bare four hundred people have made the crossing of the Bass Strait in the modern era. Before then, Aboriginal Australians sailed in their canoes the shocking distance during the last ice age. This adventure makes strategic stops on the islands along the way; however, it is one of the toughest and deadliest journeys in the world. Adventure filmmaker Beau Miles narrates the expedition as the first ever feature film of the crossing via sea kayaks. The travellers will experience chafe, storms, bad cooking and an emerging mate-ship between men that barely know each other. Watch it now with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Čuvar plaže u zimskom periodu, film
programme.desc: Odrastao u atmosferi promašenog braka svojih roditelja, mladić želi da pođe svojim putem u život. Škola koju je završio ne pruža mu šanse da se zaposli, pa zato prihvati mjesto čuvara plaže u zimskom periodu. Oženi se djevojkom koju voli, vjerujući da ljubav može da prebrodi sve teškoće. Ubrzo uvidi da su i njegovi roditelji jednom poletno počeli, ali da su taj polet ugušile životne nedaće. Žena ga napusti, otac mu umire i mladić se našao pred novim početkom, ali sada opterećen gorčinom.

programme.title: Hajka, film
programme.desc: Ostatak partizanskog odreda razbijenog prevarom, diverzijom skreće na sebe pažnju četnika, koji, umjesto pripremanog napada na Vrhovni štab NOB-a, otpočinju hajku na ranjene, gladne i slabo naoružane partizane skrivene po zemunicama. Ljudi postaju progonjene zvijeri i zvijeri koje progone. U kaosu uništenja, u bespuću, usred divljanja smrti, rađa se sin ranjenog partizana, simbol trijumfa života.

programme.title: Dečak i violina, film
programme.desc: U Domu za djecu palih boraca okupljeni su dječaci glazbeno nadareni. Među njima je i Goran, sav predan violini koja mu postaje najbolji prijatelj i uzrok mnogobrojnih nesporazuma koji će biti izglađeni zalaganjima odgojitelja.

programme.title: Dečak i violina, film

programme.title: Agi i Ema, film
programme.desc: "Agi i Ema" je dirljiva priča o usamljenom devetogodišnjaku (Stefan Lazarević), koji živi u modernoj obitelji okupiranoj poslom. Obitelj se često seli tako da Agi ne uspjeva da stekne prijatelje i nauči kako da se ophodi prema ljudima. Njegov život se mijenja kada upozna Emu (Milena Dravić), živahnu i neobičnu staru gospođu. Ema je vedra i radoznala starica koja Agiju prilazi otvorenog srca i daje mu ono što mu je u tom trenutku najpotrebnije - potpuno prijateljstvo. Na kreativan i suptilan način, ona izvlači Agija iz svijeta samoće u koji je on gotovo nasilno gurnut. Odrasli ih ne primjećuju, grde ih ili im se smiju, ali njih dvoje strpljivo i razigrano žive onaj život u kome je čovjek važniji od pravila i sistema, i ljubav važnija od beskrajnog posla ili novog automobila.

programme.title: Mare, film
programme.desc: Mare nikada nije letjela, iako živi tik do zračne luke sa suprugom i njihovo troje djece tinejdžerske dobi. Voli svoju obitelj, brine se za njih, ali katkad se gotovo osjeća kao stranac u vlastitom domu. Tko su ti ljudi s kojima živi? Mare se zatekne kako promatra zrakoplove nad sobom i čezne za promjenom i nepoznatim. Kad se jednog dana mladić useli u susjednu kuću, ona stavlja svoj život na kušnju.

programme.title: Mehanizam, film
programme.desc: Sukob između nevinosti i zla je najkraća definicija lajtmotiva ovog filma. Priča se događa jednog zimskog dana u zabačenoj provinciji, daleko od svih velikih događaja koji potresaju današnji svijet. Mlada žena, učiteljica, ide u udaljeno selo gdje je dobila svoj prvi posao poslije šest godina čekanja. Sretna i puna nade želi da njezin život konačno počne...Drugi glavni lik je sličan njoj. Vraća se iz rata u kojem, ustvari, nije ni sudjelovao jer je već prvog dana ranjen i proveo je u bolnici osam mjeseci. Njegov prvi posao je posao taksista na pustoj željezničkoj stanici na kojoj nema mnogo putnika, ali nudi mir koji mu je potreban da prebrodi svoje traume i koji budi nadu da će mu se konačno dogoditi nešto lijepo. Ali, surova vremena prijete da će uništiti snove učiteljici i taksistu. Sreću čovjeka koji je mlad kao i oni, ali on ima potpuno drugačije ciljeve u životu...

programme.title: Tajvanska kanasta, film
programme.desc: Četrdesetogodišnji nezaposleni arhitekt zaokupljen je izradom "mrdalica", nekakvih suludih pokretnih skulptura koje niko osim njega ne shvaća ozbiljno. Takav, potpuno odgovara grupi sumnjivih tipova koji ga polako asimiliraju.

programme.title: Crvena zemlja, film
programme.desc: Godine 1941. partizani oslobađaju Užice i Čačak te vode borbu za Kraljevo. Njemci, u cilju odmazde, strijeljaju 6.000 građana Kraljeva.

programme.title: Optimisti, film
programme.desc: Pet filmskih priča inspirirano je čuvenim Voltaireovim djelom "Candide". "Optimizam je kad netko uporno tvrdi da je sve dobro kada je sve loše." Događa se u naše vrijeme, u Srbiji poslije Miloševića. Obojene crnim humorom, to su priče o vremenu u kojem se prožimaju očajanje i nada, stvarni i lažni optimizam, fikcija i stvarnost, u kojem mnogi love u mutnom na ruševinama izgubljenih iluzija.

programme.title: Đavolja varoš, film
programme.desc: Film o ljudima koje vode osnovne ljudske potrebe - instinkti, opsesije, ambicije, strahovi i frustracije. Skup različitih likova čiji se putevi isprepliću u jednom danu...

programme.title: Igmanski marš, film
programme.desc: Krajem siječnja 1942. godine Prva proleterska brigada se na Romaniji našla opkoljena jakim njemačkim snagama. Štab brigade donosi odluku o izvršenju opasnog, ali jedino mogućeg pokreta. Trebalo je proći pored Sarajeva, preko Igmana, prema oslobođenoj Foči. Igmanski marš je izveden noću između 27. i 28. siječnja, po dubokom snijegu i velikoj hladnoći. Taj marš postaje legenda, a četrdeset teško promrzlih boraca prebačeno je na liječenje u Foču, gdje su junački podnijeli nadljudske bolove amputiranja promrzlih dijelova tijela bez narkoze.

programme.title: Igmanski marš, film
programme.desc: Krajem siječnja 1942. godine Prva proleterska brigada se na Romaniji našla opkoljena jakim njemačkim snagama. Štab brigade donosi odluku o izvršenju opasnog, ali jedino mogućeg pokreta. Trebalo je proći pored Sarajeva, preko Igmana, prema oslobođenoj Foči. Igmanski marš je izveden noću između 27. i 28. siječnja, po dubokom snijegu i velikoj hladnoći. Taj marš postaje legenda, a četrdeset teško promrzlih boraca prebačeno je na liječenje u Foču, gdje su junački podnijeli nadljudske bolove amputiranja promrzlih dijelova tijela bez narkoze.

programme.title: Leptirov oblak, film
programme.desc: Kraj djetinjstva, prva ljubav i nesporazumi koji izgledaju neriješivi. Komična priča o šesnaestogodišnjem dječaku kojem se čini da se sve urotilo protiv njegovih snova - i porodica, i prijatelji, i svijet iz samoposluge u kojoj je zaposlen. Sam sebi liči na leptira koji bježi pred teškim kišnim oblakom.

programme.title: Barabe! film
programme.desc: Kovač i Dara, čija su djetinjstva puna nesreće, upoznaju se u sirotištu i vežu jedno uz drugog. Deset godina kasnije slučajno se susreću kao tinejdžeri. Kovač je vođa bande a Dara živi sama u svom vlastitom svijetu. Kovačeva banda zapliće se u sve ozbiljnije ilegalne poslove. Odani različitim gangsterima i lovljeni od strane korumpiranog policajca, njihove mladenačke iluzije se rasplinju a povratak nazad čini se gotovo nemogućim.

Les McCann: Live in New Orleans, Smooth
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album Swiss Movement which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today’s broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann’s vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including Just Like Magic, backed by his wonderful Magic Band of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet, Jazz
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills. While normally considered a jazz artist, her music incorporates a mix of folk, ethnic music, modern jazz, avant-garde, electronica, symphonic and other genres. In this intimate venue, João's vocally and physically dynamic performance creates an electrifying atmosphere.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris, Soul
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris, Soul
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Turquoise, Concert
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the artists performing here in 2019 is Al Di Meola. This pioneering guitarist blends world music, rock and jazz. His ongoing fascination for complex rhythmic syncopation, combined with provocative lyrical melodies and sophisticated harmony, has been at the heart of his music throughout a celebrated career. The Grammy Award-winner has achieved international fame both as a solo artist and due to his collaborations with the world's biggest artists.

programme.title: Jones Thad, A Child Is Born, Concert
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz, Smooth
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. After beginning his career in the Love Unlimited Orchestra, he now brings his own band for this hypnotic performance.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker, Modern
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’. In this concert Fay Claassen brings a tribute to Baker with the most beautiful songs and improvisations.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Documentary

programme.title: Martin Goyette - Spectacle Astral 2017, Jazz
programme.desc: A veteran bluesman that can hold his head high next to our neighbors to the south, Martin Goyette made his bones with an undeniable and incredible voice. Powerful, whisky-throated and raw, it drives home the sound, twinned with his super-watt harmonica playing. The Montreal artist arrives with songs from a new album released in 2013, Sweet Warm Jelly, a sonic jam of blues, jazz and gospel guaranteed to warm the heart. In 2002, he won Le Prix de la Relève at Festiblues International de Montréal leading the formation Riverside Blues. Then he toured France as an opening act for Mr. Bob Walsh. More recently, Martin played the Montreal International Jazz Festival, Sherblues Festival, au Tremblant International Blues Festival, Trois-Rivières en Blues, Joliette’s October Blues or as an opening act for the prince of soul and funk, Lee Fields.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985, World
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss, Urban
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’. In this episode, Zurich serves as a backdrop for sets by pianist Stefan Rusconi, Grand Pianoramax, and Nik Bartsch.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West, Concert
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic stretch music; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah’s quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Mi niño curro, Concert
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival. However, the similarities between flamenco and blues have been well documented: both are the outlet for a poor, disenfranchised minority, with a primitive strength, boundless capabilities for improvisation and a requirement for breathtaking virtuosity - all qualities shown by Paco de Lucía in this performance. Moreover, he has long been experimenting with jazz forms (evident even from his inclusion of bass, drums, and saxophone in his sextet), while still retaining the essence of the flamenco tradition. In his own words: What I have tried to do is have a hand holding onto tradition and the other scratching, digging in other places trying to find new things I can bring into flamenco.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa. In 1974, The Headhunters appeared on German television, playing Palm Grease, Sly, Butterfly, Spank-A-Lee, and Chameleon. Hancock (keys) is joined by Bennie Maupin (saxophones), Paul Jackson (electric bass), Mike Clark (drums) and Bill Summer (percussion).

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Steven Delannoye, Free
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. New York is Jazz Heaven: small wonder that many young Belgian musicians cross the ocean to try their musical luck in the ‘Big Apple’. One of these journeymen brings the fruits of his successful New York experiences to this MotorMusic Session: tenor saxophone player Steven Delannoye and his New York Trio join forces with saxophonist Frank Vaganée. The intense and intriguing dialogue between the two saxophones recalls the golden jazz age of the 1950s, but adds a freshness of approach that is defined by their respective experiences. The horns are underpinned by the powerful NYC-based rhythm section of drummer Jesse Simpson and bassist Desmond White, who contribute a vibrant energy that propels the saxophonists to lofty heights.
